proposedOverrides.summary: Monumental centers at Heketa and Lapaha, imported stone tools and finely made household objects illuminate the Tu'i Tonga chiefly world. Sacred rank and governing power changed across successive lines. The last Tu'i Tonga died in 1865; Tongan society continued.

proposedOverrides.summary: Tonga's modern kingdom is known for continuing monarchy, parliamentary government, ngatu barkcloth and language-centered community life. A constitution and parliament emerged in 1875. British protected-state status ended in 1970, while Tongan cultural life continues at home and overseas.
